scripts.dev: npm run build -w @virtual-workspace/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @virtual-workspace/shared" "npm run dev -w @virtual-workspace/backend" "npm run dev -w @virtual-workspace/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @virtual-workspace/shared && npm run build -w @virtual-workspace/backend && npm run build -w @virtual-workspace/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @virtual-workspace/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
